focus.jnote: The backdrop is friendly, but the scan came up empty — and that is the whole story today. The S&P 500 rose ~0.65% Thursday to a record ~7,799, clearing 7,800 intraday for the first time, after July PPI printed unchanged on the month and reinforced expectations the Fed holds in September; the Nasdaq added ~0.81% to ~26,803 and the Dow was roughly flat near ~53,840. Futures this morning are mixed and little changed. Oil is steady — WTI ~$81, Brent ~$87 — even as the Strait of Hormuz stays severely constrained and the U.S.–Iran war grinds into its sixth month. The VIX is low near ~14.7. But the full-universe scanner boarded no names: 9 Type A gaps confirmed but none qualified, 1 Type B catalyst with no confirmed gap, and 3 Type C breakouts none of which boarded. With nothing to underwrite, there is no trade to make.
focus.notdown: No bullish single-name boarded. The record-setting tape and soft PPI would normally favor bull puts, but the Type A earnings scan (366 reporters → 33 in-universe → 9 gaps confirmed → 0 boarded) and the Type C breakout scan (940 examined → 3 breakouts confirmed → 0 boarded) both came up empty on quality/validation. Do NOT invent a setup from the headlines — if the scan didn’t board it, it isn’t a Sniper today. Stand aside.
focus.notup: No bearish single-name boarded either. The Type B scan found only 1 universe ticker with a catalyst and it did not confirm a gap that cleared the bar. Selling bear calls into a record-high, low-VIX tape is a squeeze risk anyway, and there is no confirmed gap-down name to lean on. The disciplined answer is to sell nothing new today.
focus.why: Why YELLOW, not GREEN? The gap-risk numbers are benign — composite 44 (MILD) and P(≥1% gap) ~30%, both under the triggers — but a GREEN light means deploy normal size, and there is nothing to deploy into: the scanner boarded zero qualifying setups. On top of that, the U.S.–Iran war and a constrained Strait of Hormuz remain an open-ended geopolitical tail even with oil easing. The honest stance is YELLOW by default: no new credit spreads today, keep cash, and re-run the scan Monday pre-open when the calendar refills.

risks: Nothing boarded — don’t force a trade — the single biggest risk on a zero-setup day is inventing a setup from the news to feel productive. The scan ran and cleared no names; the disciplined move is to sell no new premium and wait for Monday’s re-run.

Strait of Hormuz & the Iran war — the waterway remains severely constrained in the sixth month of the U.S.–Iran war, and the UAE reported two of its tankers attacked Thursday. Any re-escalation sends crude and the whole tape gapping — the open-ended tail.

Oil & the 10-year — WTI ~$81 / Brent ~$87 with global stockpiles dwindling per the IEA; the 10Y sits ~4.68%. A supply-driven oil re-spike would revive inflation fear and pressure long-duration stocks.
Record-high complacency — the S&P just cleared 7,800 with the VIX near 14.7; low vol at records leaves little cushion, so any surprise headline gaps harder than the calm tape implies.

Next week’s calendar — with this week’s CPI/PPI cleared, watch for retail sales, jobless claims, and any August-CPI-relevant Fed commentary that could reset September rate-path odds and re-introduce event risk.
RDDT joins the S&P 500 (before 8/18 open) — index-inclusion flows can distort single-name and sector prints early next week; not a Sniper setup, just noise to be aware of.
